units.label: Dashboard — error state on API failure

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Workspace overview renders activeCount cleanly once summary resolves
finding.detail: Populated state displays active campaign count with a nullish fallback to 0.
finding.recommendation: No change required on the populated overview.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Unrouted first-run wizard asks new users for internal schema version and priority
finding.detail: Sweep 1b found a state-switched wizard (currentStep === "welcome") that prompts a first-time user for "Priority (Low / Medium / High)" and "Internal schema version" before they have seen the workspace.
finding.recommendation: Remove the Priority and Internal schema version inputs from the welcome step.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Survey header states a clear 3-respondent privacy floor to participants
finding.detail: The survey header explicitly promises respondents that leadership only sees a combined reading once at least 3 teammates have completed the checkup.
finding.recommendation: Enforce this 3-respondent privacy floor on every admin read surface.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Invitations table leaks individual respondent scores and raw surveyHash bearer links
finding.detail: Every row in InvitationsScreen prints p.individualScore% by name and renders /survey/{p.surveyHash} in the DOM, breaking the privacy promise in survey.jsx:9-13 and exposing each participant bearer token.
finding.recommendation: Remove the Individual Score and Magic Link columns from InvitationsScreen; show only Name and Completed/Pending status.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Completed vs Pending status column gives clear per-participant progress feedback
finding.detail: The Status column cleanly distinguishes Completed from Pending respondents without exposing answers.
finding.recommendation: Keep the Name and Status columns as the sole columns in InvitationsScreen.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Upgrade to Pro button hardcodes plan: "business" in checkout payload
finding.detail: startUpgrade(selectedTier) ignores selectedTier for the plan key and sends { plan: "business", sourceTier: selectedTier }, making the highlighted Pro plan impossible to buy.
finding.recommendation: Pass plan: selectedTier in startUpgrade at src/screens/billing.jsx:8.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: Invoices empty state is a bare "No invoices" string
finding.detail:
When invoices.length === 0, BillingScreen renders a bare
No invoices
with no explanation of when invoices appear.
finding.recommendation: Replace the bare string at src/screens/billing.jsx:31 with an empty state explaining that invoices appear after the first billing cycle.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: LegacyV1Modal uses low-contrast #ccc text on #fff background
finding.detail: Inline style sets color: #ccc on background: #fff.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: SQL injection in attachMembersToCampaign via sql template literal
finding.detail: attachMembersToCampaign interpolates campaignId and memberId into sql`...` template strings.
finding.recommendation: Use parameterized queries instead of template strings.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: attachMembersToCampaign does not scope memberIds to currentUser.tenantId (cross-tenant IDOR)
finding.detail: attachMembersToCampaign verifies campaign ownership at line 5, but loads each memberId with WHERE id = ${memberId} only (line 15), allowing any tenant to attach another tenant's members to their campaign.
finding.recommendation: Add AND tenant_id = ${currentUser.tenantId} to the members lookup in src/actions/team-actions.js:15.

why: Pass 1 appraisal against the lens rubric.

finding.title: attachMembersToCampaign executes an unbounded 2N sequential query loop per memberId
finding.detail: Lines 14-21 run a sequential SELECT and INSERT inside for (const memberId of memberIds) with no batching or length cap, causing 2N DB round-trips.
finding.recommendation: Replace the per-member SELECT/INSERT loop with a single batched WHERE id = ANY($1) query and multi-row INSERT.

why: Leaking named individual scores and raw surveyHash links directly violates the privacy promise on survey.jsx:9-13; outranks UI polish.
